Over 200 random splits per cell, a pilot of $m{=}30$ items gives the prediction and the remaining items are held out; the splits of one cell overlap, so they are not independent tests. Accuracy: share of splits whose adopt decision matches the sign of the held-out $\Delta$ (not adopting is correct when $\Delta\le0$); MAE: mean absolute error of the predicted $\Delta$, in points.
